description: Bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Etalab. Liste des bornes de recharge de véhicules en Pays de la Loire consolidée à partir des données transmises par les syndicat d'énergie conformément au décret décret n° 2017-26 du 12 janvier 2017. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are véhicules électriques, TEO, IRVE. The portal shows 8,394 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
